catalog.title: Resolve consequential uncertainties
rules: Resolve missing decisions about inputs, outputs and failure behavior before dependent work; inspect provided context first.
Reuse settled decisions. Ask only a necessary unresolved question through the existing protocol; do not restart an interview.

catalog.title: Keep responsibilities and interfaces clear
rules: Give state and behavior clear owners; expose small complete interfaces and settle dependency contracts before implementation.
Preserve approved boundaries. Change architecture only for a demonstrated contract defect, not a local implementation failure.

catalog.title: Test observable behavior in small steps
rules: For nontrivial behavior, use a small failing public-interface check, implement the required behavior, then verify it passes.
Derive expectations from the task, not the implementation. Avoid private-method mocks and new tests for trivial cosmetic edits.

catalog.title: Observe real browser behavior
rules: Use available browser tooling to exercise the actual user flow and inspect visible state; a successful build is not browser evidence.
Use current element references and isolated sessions for separate users. Report unavailable browser checks instead of claiming success.

catalog.title: Design for this product and its content
rules: Follow the supplied visual direction and existing tokens; choose hierarchy, spacing and typography for the real content.
Keep responsive layouts and useful empty/error states. Avoid decorative features or assets that the task does not need.

catalog.title: Keep React rendering and data flow efficient
rules: Avoid serial waits for independent data and unnecessary client imports; keep rendering free of effects that duplicate derived state.
Clean up subscriptions and listeners, keep effect dependencies accurate, and add memoization only for demonstrated expensive work.

catalog.title: Keep interfaces accessible and usable
rules: Use semantic controls, accessible names, keyboard operation and visible focus; retain readable contrast and reduced-motion support.
Handle narrow screens, long content, loading and validation errors without hiding essential controls or changing the task's UI contract.

catalog.title: Review correctness against the actual task
rules: Check task coverage and repository conventions separately; trace changed behavior through callers and failure paths.
Report concrete defects with evidence and location. Keep optional style preferences separate from defects and avoid unrelated rewrites.

catalog.title: Repair the demonstrated cause
rules: Reproduce the failure and trace data through the failing boundary before editing; distinguish environment failure from code failure.
Test one causal hypothesis with a focused regression check. Keep local repairs local and report contract conflicts through the coordinator.

catalog.title: Tie completion to evidence
rules: Check the final artifact with the task's acceptance commands; read their exit status and results before reporting completion.
Distinguish passed, failed and unrun checks. Never replace a behavioral test with a weaker assertion or claim runtime proof from static checks.

ponytail.title: Smallest complete solution
rules: Read the affected flow and callers; reuse existing code, then the standard library. Add only what the task needs.
Prefer one root-cause fix and a focused check over wrappers, speculative abstractions, dependencies or broad rewrites.
